final_answer:
The bug was in `compute_tax` in `src/invoicer/tax.py`. It truncated with `//`, but ADR 0001 says every division must round half up. Because of that, 1005 cents at 8.25% gave 82 instead of 83, and the CLI total showed tax of 1.23 instead of 1.24.

I changed it to use `money.round_half_up(subtotal_cents * rate_bp, 10_000)`. After the change, all 10 tests pass. I ran them with `python -m unittest`, because pytest isn't installed here.

I haven't committed the change.

input.command: cd <WORK>/repo && ls && git ls-files && (npm test 2>&1 || python -m pytest 2>&1) | tail -40
cd <WORK>/repo && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -40; cat src/invoicer/tax.py src/invoicer/money.py docs/adr/0001-integer-cents.md

cd <WORK>/repo && sed -i 's|^    return subtotal_cents \* rate_bp // 10_000|    return round_half_up(subtotal_cents * rate_bp, 10_000)|; 1a\
\
from .money import round_half_up' src/invoicer/tax.py && head -8 src/invoicer/tax.py && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -4
